action.command: ls -la /workspace/node_modules | wc -l; ls /workspace/node_modules | grep -cE '^\.'; node -e "const p=require('/workspace/package.json'); const fs=require('fs'); let missing=[]; for (const d of {...p.dependencies, ...p.devDependencies}) if(!fs.existsSync('/workspace/node_modules/'+d)) missing.push(d); console.log('missing deps:', missing.length? missing : 'none')"
